## Configuration

## Reproduction

What did you do, what happened, and what did you expect?
Does a fresh Matter read or control succeed, or is only cached state visible?
Is another OTBR app running?

## Relevant logs

Include timestamps. Redact credentials, datasets, pairing codes, private keys,
location and backup contents. Do not attach a full flash dump or HA backup.
